images.title: The diagonals of a rhombus cross at right angles
images.purpose: Shows rhombus GAME whose diagonals GM = 8 cm and EA = 6 cm bisect each other at O at 90°.
images.composition: Plain white background, the main object large and centred with wide empty margins, no scenery, no characters, no extra decoration. One large rhombus standing on a corner in the centre with its two unequal diagonals and a right angle mark.
images.exact_structure: One rhombus GAME in dark outline standing on a corner, vertices in order G, A, M, E going round: G on the left, A at the top, M on the right, E at the bottom. The horizontal diagonal GM is a thick teal (#0072B2) line, the vertical diagonal EA a thick amber (#E69F00) line, shorter than GM in the ratio 6 to 8; they cross at O. A small filled reddish purple (#CC79A7) square right angle mark at O. All four sides carry one identical short tick mark. The label 4 cm sits above GO and the label 3 cm sits left of EO. The letters G, A, M, E sit outside their corners and O below and right of the crossing. Nothing else in the frame.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
images.takeaway: The diagonals of a rhombus bisect each other at right angles, but they need not be equal.
images.description: Shows rhombus GAME whose diagonals GM = 8 cm and EA = 6 cm bisect each other at O at 90°.
images.context: GO = 8 ÷ 2 = 4 cm, EO = 6 ÷ 2 = 3 cm; SSS on ∆GEO and ∆MEO gives 90° at O.

image_decisions.why: Unequal diagonals with a right angle at the crossing show exactly what a rhombus adds to a parallelogram.
